ns2:course.label: Career Development for PhDs
ns2:course.description: This course is intended to help doctoral candidates transition into careers in or out of academia. The class covers job market processes and strategies, presentation skills, teaching philosophies, and development of research trajectories. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: ACE 561.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: ACE 561.
